title: ccwa-world-heavyweight
label: Ronnie McNeil
how: Defeated Johnny Dollar at Sensation, reversing a second Bottom Dollar attempt into the fall.
note: Retained the title in a No Contest against Tony Stecchino on 22 Feb 2005 after Eddie B.'s interference; still billed champion in the fed's own 14 Mar 2005 news, set to defend against Lyger.

title: ccwa-world-heavyweight
label: Johnny Dollar

won.source: No record of how or when this reign began survives; the fed's own December 2004 hack lost roughly twenty results. The fed's own roster page carries him already as champion.

how: Lost to Ronnie McNeil at Sensation — Dollar's own Bottom Dollar was kicked out of once, and McNeil reversed a second attempt into the fall.

title: ccwa-north-american
label: Danielle Northsky
how: Defeated Furious at Sensation with her own Spirit Way, after reversing his powerbomb attempt into a swinging DDT.
note: Billed against Psyno (late Feb/March 2005 news and the Boise card's own main event) and a debuting Sylkk (14 Mar 2005 news); no result for either challenge survives, and no further title change is recorded before the corpus ends.

title: ccwa-north-american
label: Furious

won.source: No record of how or when this reign began survives; the fed's own December 2004 hack lost roughly twenty results.

how: Lost to Danielle Northsky at Sensation — Furious reversed her powerbomb attempt into a swinging DDT of his own, but Northsky's own Spirit Way finished him.

title: ccwa-television
label: Chris West
how: Won the inaugural Television Championship at Sensation, pinning Wayne "Freezer Burn" Hammond in a barbed-wire match after Chris Sanchez's own interference.
note: Stripped by Tony Stecchino on 22 Feb 2005 — the physical belt thrown into the crowd — the same night West was fired from the roster. The title itself is declared retired by the fed's own 14 Mar 2005 news, replaced by the new Flash Championship; no third reign is recorded.

title: ccwa-tag-team
label: The Dead
how: Won the titles in their own CCWA debut at Sensation, pinning Pete Hardy — standing in as Psyno's last-minute tag partner for the injured no-show Justin Warner.
note: Retained against a #1 contenders match won by Painkiller and Freezer Burn (over Chris Sanchez and Chris West's own TFL pairing) at The Show; the challenge itself is not recorded before the corpus ends.
